hero.headingLine2: kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo.
hero.paragraph: Kuva ku bwikorezi bw'ihuse bw'umuzigo umwe kugeza ku bwikorezi bunini bukoresha API. Reba serivisi zifatika n'iz'ikoranabuhanga dukoresha kugira ngo ubucuruzi bwawe bukure.

services.title: Urutonde runini rw'Ubucuruzi (B2B)
services.shortDesc: Uburyo bwikoresha bwo kohereza ibicuruzwa byinshi ku bucuruzi bunini.
services.description: Reka kwandika amabwiriza ku giti cyawe. Ohereza urutonde rwawe rwa buri munsi ukoresheje CSV cyangwa API, maze uburyo bwacu bukohereze, bugerageze, kandi buhe abakozi bacu bo mu mujyi gutanga ibicuruzwa. Byakorewe uruganda rw'ubucuruzi kuri interineti, abasaba ibicuruzwa, n'abafatanyabikorwa binini bakeneye kohereza amagana y'imizigo ku munsi nta ngorane.

services.title: Umukozi Uboneka Igihe Ushaka
services.shortDesc: Kohereza umuzigo umwe vuba cyane hirya no hino i Kigali.
services.description: Igihe bigomba kugera ubu nonaha. Saba umukozi ako kanya binyuze kuri urubuga rwacu cyangwa WhatsApp. Dutanga icyizere cyo gutora vuba no gutanga ibicuruzwa inzu ku nzu nta gihe cyo kubika mu bubiko. Byiza cyane ku nyandiko z'ihutirwa, itumiza rimwe rimwe mu bucuruzi, no ku bwikorezi bw'ibice by'ihutirwa.

specs.label: Gukurikirana
specs.value: Ihuza rya GPS mu Gihe Nyacyo

services.title: Gucunga Kwishyura Igihe cyo Gutanga (COD)
services.shortDesc: Gukusanya no kwishyura amafaranga mu buryo bwizewe kandi bugenzurwa.
services.description: Kwishyura igihe cyo gutanga ni ihame ry'ubucuruzi bw'aho iwacu, ariko gukurikirana kwishyura bigabanya umuvuduko wawe. Turinda amafaranga yawe ako kanya ibicuruzwa bigeze aho bijyanwa. Abakozi bacu banditse ku buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga icyo bakusanyije, kandi ishami ryacu ry'imari rikohereza amafaranga yose ku konti yawe ya banki cyangwa mobile money yemejwe mu masaha 48.

services.title: Ubwikorezi mu Ntara
services.description: Gura isoko ryawe nta kugira umuparata wawe bwite. Dukora ingendo z'ubwikorezi zitunganijwe zerekeza ku bigo binini by'intara mu gihugu hose kandi dutegura ubwikorezi bwizewe cyane bunyura ku mipaka bujya mu masoko ari hafi nka DRC na Uganda.

cta.heading: Ntabwo uzi urwego rukwiye?
cta.paragraph: Reka itsinda ryacu ry'imikorere rigenzure umubare w'ibicuruzwa utanga ubu maze ryubake uburyo bw'ibiciro bwihariye bukura hamwe nawe.
